description: Geospatial Dataset of the Public Space Accessibility Tool (PSAT) at the Street-Segment Level: Monterrey Metropolitan Area, Mexico is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors ANTONIO ALFONSO BARREDA LUNA, Omar Rodriguez Abreo (Autonomous University of Queretaro). This dataset provides a high-resolution geospatial representation of the Public Space Accessibility Tool (PSAT) at the street-segment level in the Monterrey Metropolitan Area, Mexico. It integrates variables related to infrastructure, urban activities, and transport structure, enabling spatial analysis of accessibility conditions. Coverage: national (MX); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
